overview.title: Overview
body: Revenue metrics are derived from the account records and move live with account activity. Product analytics describe the whole user base and come from their own data.

Select a metric to chart it, and turn on Compare to overlay the previous period. Deltas compare the latest month with the month before the range starts; percent metrics change in percentage points (pp).
items: The region selector in the top navigation, or the donut, scopes revenue, accounts and activity. Product analytics are not split by region.
Hover the trend chart, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to inspect months.

activity.title: Live activity
body: Account events stream in while live activity is on. Pause it from this container or from the footer. Events follow the selected region.

customers.title: Customers
body: Named accounts across plans, owners and regions. Filters combine, and the region from the top navigation applies here too.
Select rows to export or star them in bulk from Actions. Choose a row to open account details.
items: Press / to jump to the search field.
Health combines seat usage, activity and billing signals into a score out of 100.

account.title: Account details
body: MRR history, seat usage, renewal date and key moments for one account. Notes are saved in this browser only.
Previous and next follow the current order and filters of the customers table.

analytics.title: Analytics
body: Revenue shows where MRR changed over the last 30 days and how it splits by plan, from account records. Product analytics cover the signup funnel and cohort retention for the whole user base.

settings.title: Settings
body: Theme, density and motion call Cloudscape's applyMode, applyDensity and disableMotion helpers. All preferences are stored in this browser.

revenue.title: Revenue
body: MRR is the sum of paying accounts' monthly recurring revenue; trials are excluded. Paying accounts counts accounts with MRR in a month, and average MRR per account divides the two.
The current month is live: upgrades, seat changes and conversions in the activity feed update it immediately. Earlier months are generated history for each account.
MRR movement groups the last 30 days of account events: conversions are new, upgrades and added seats are expansion, removed seats are contraction.

product.title: Product analytics
body: Active users, trial conversion, D30 retention, acquisition mix, the signup funnel and cohort retention describe the whole user base. The account records do not model users or signups, so these come from their own data and are not split by region.
